findings.title: Failed migrations invisible on stderr under --json
findings.problem: silent is now true for --json, so MigrationRunner.runPending prints no '✗ Failed/Error' line, and logger.error writes to the console only in debug mode. A migration that returns success:false or throws inside up() is recorded only in the log file; the wrapper ignores runPending's returned { failed } count. The plan constraint says a failed migration's warning stays on stderr.
findings.impact: A script or CI job consuming --json gets valid JSON and exit 0 with no signal that start-up migrations failed (they retry on every run); before this change the failure was at least visible on stdout. No test asserts stderr for a failing migration.
findings.recommendation: Keep the result of runPending in bin/codemie.js and, when result.failed > 0 and the run is silent only because of isMachineOutput (not a hook), write one line to stderr via console.error (e.g. 'Warning: N migration(s) failed; see the log file') while leaving stdout untouched; hooks keep logger.warn behaviour. Add a test that a failing migration under --json produces stderr text and still-valid JSON on stdout.
